results.name: Manufacturer Daily inline measurements populate Water and Noise trends from the actual local reader
Slice thickness has millimetre charts and opens its exact cached source page without hidden analysis
Monthly alignment measurements keep separate printed millimetre series and exact source pages
A real table-position read refreshes the visible chart and keeps eight printed method-position series separate
Content-identical real snapshots do not restart an already displayed trend chart

scope: Actual local host and Standard PDF reader; generated Daily inline HU rows, water/noise coverage, slice/alignment/table millimetre charts, semantic snapshot refresh and exact cached source-page navigation. Focused Linux/new-metric scope: bundled Windows Python and the first four full-workload scenarios are not executed. No report/API mocks or uploaded clinical documents.
